Website for Alice Palazzo, live at alicepalazzo.com.

Built with Next.js, React and TypeScript, styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components, with photo galleries laid out by react-photo-album.

Development

bun install
bun run dev      # Next.js dev server with Turbopack
bun run build    # production build
bun run lint

Deployment

Every push to main builds the site with GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/nextjs.yml) and publishes it to GitHub Pages under the custom domain in CNAME. CI installs from package-lock.json.
